notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: There is nothing at this address.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Your text is kept. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: The e-mail or password is not right.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before signing in again.
errors.invalid_invitation: This invitation is not valid or has expired. Ask an administrator for a new one.
errors.weak_password: The password is too short. Use at least 12 characters, and a name.
errors.http_401: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.http_403: You do not have access to this.
errors.http_404: This consultation does not exist or is not yours to see.
errors.not_found: This consultation does not exist or is not yours to see.
errors.empty_catalog: The catalog has no building blocks yet.
errors.catalog_invalid: The catalog has errors that block a consultation. An architect needs to fix them.
errors.invalid_input: That input is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.nothing_to_explain: There is no result to explain yet.
errors.llm_unavailable: The language model is not available right now. Your text is kept; try again in a moment.
errors.llm_output_rejected: The language model returned something the catalog does not accept, even after a second attempt. Your text is kept; try again or rephrase it.
errors.llm_error: The language model request failed. Your text is kept; try again.
errors.llm_not_configured: No language model is configured on this server. Ask an administrator.
errors.stale: Someone else saved this item in the meantime. Their version and the differences are shown; nothing you typed is lost.
errors.unknown_reference: This refers to something that is not in the catalog.
errors.conflict: This could not be done because of the current state. Reload and check.
errors.constraint: The catalog does not accept this combination.
errors.invalid_document: The file is not a valid catalog document.
errors.validation_errors: The import has errors that must be fixed first.
errors.http_409: This could not be done because of the current state. Reload and check.
errors.already_open: This item already has an open discussion. Join it instead.
errors.missing_responses: Answer every opposing position before deciding.
errors.invalid: That is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.http_422: That is not valid. Check it and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Use the account an administrator created for you.

list.title: Consultations
list.intro: Each consultation turns a requirement into the building blocks it needs and the solutions that fit.

new.title: New consultation
new.intro: Describe the requirement in your own words. Cheshire maps it to the catalog; the choice stays with you.
new.requirement_hint: Plain text. You can rewrite it later; earlier versions stay readable.
new.requirement_empty: Write the requirement before analyzing it.
new.name: Name (optional)
new.name_hint: Shown in your list. Defaults to the start of the requirement.

session.old_revision: You are reading revision {{ n }}. The latest is revision {{ latest }}. Earlier revisions cannot be changed.
session.empty_catalog: The catalog has no building blocks yet.
session.empty_catalog_architect: Add some in the catalog, then try again.
session.unrecognised: No building block in the catalog matched this text. It was recorded as an unrecognised requirement for the architects. You can rephrase it below.
session.not_analyzed: This requirement has not been analyzed yet.

requirement.title: Requirement
requirement.text_label: Requirement text with the understood parts marked
requirement.rewrite_hint: Analyzing again creates a new revision. The current one stays readable.

understood.title: What was understood
understood.no_facts: No facts were read from the text.
understood.rule_abbs_note: Building blocks the rules add cannot be removed here. If one is wrong, send feedback below.

questions.title: Open questions
questions.none: Nothing is waiting for an answer.

summary.title: Result summary
summary.rules_not_validated: {{ n }} of {{ total }} rules this result rests on are not yet validated.

abbs.title: Building blocks
abbs.gap: No solution registered in the catalog for this building block. It was recorded for the architects.
abbs.open_questions: Open questions that affect this block:

trace.empty: This entry belongs to an earlier result and is no longer available here.

comparison.title: Comparison
comparison.note: Built from declared facts only. Columns are alphabetical; nothing here ranks the options.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.writing: Writing the explanation from the rule trace…
rationale.none: No explanation has been written yet.
rationale.outdated: Outdated: the answers changed after this was written. Update it to match the current result.
rationale.unverified: {{ n }} sentence(s) could not be checked against the rule trace and are marked.

choices.title: Record the choice
choices.intro: Your choice is recorded with your name and the time. Cheshire never chooses for you.
choices.outside: Will be handled outside the catalog
choices.reason_required: A reason is required when the solution is conditional or deprecating.
choices.conditional_warning: This choice is conditional. Still unresolved:

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: Tell the architects what the catalog got wrong or does not cover.
feedback.text_required: Describe what is missing or wrong.
feedback.queue_note: Feedback goes to the architects' queue.

export.title: Export
export.intro: Requirement, facts, result, rationale and recorded choices.

pin.title: Reference case
pin.intro: Pin this result as a reference case: catalog changes will be checked against it.
pin.name: Name of the reference case

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.intro: What the catalog knows, how healthy it is, and what is waiting to be captured.
catalog.empty_body: Start with a starter pack, create the first building block, or let an interview draft it with you.

queue.title: Work queue
queue.expiring: Your claim ends soon. Renew it to keep working on this.

queue_kind.gap: Gaps: building blocks used with no solution
queue_kind.unrecognised: Requirements nothing in the catalog matched

item.pending: Version {{ n }} is waiting; the version above stays in use until it is validated.
item.usage_flagged: times flagged as missing or wrong
item.archive_blocked: {{ n }} items still use this, so it cannot be archived yet. Change them first.
item.archive_hint: Archiving keeps the history and hides the item from consultations.
item.no_decisions: No decision has been recorded for this item yet.

impact.title: Impact of this change
impact.not_effective: As proposed this version would not be used yet: a validated version stays in use until this one is validated. The preview shows what happens once it is.
impact.dependents: Items that refer to this one: {{ n }}
impact.already_differs: This case already differs from what was pinned, before this change.

builder.except: Except when all of these hold

edit.title: Edit {{ id }}
edit.stale: Someone saved version {{ version }} while you were editing. Your text is kept.
edit.id_hint: Letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores. It cannot be changed later.
edit.name: Name
edit.json_hint: The same shape as the catalog files and the export.
edit.save_disabled: Fix the points above to save.

try.title: Try it
try.intro: Set values and see what this rule would say. Nothing is saved.

vocabulary.intro: Attributes, characteristics and lenses. Keys never change; to rename one, add a new one and archive the old.

cases.title: Reference cases
cases.intro: Pinned consultations that say how the catalog should behave. Every change is replayed over them before you save.
cases.empty: No consultation is pinned yet. Architects can pin one from its page.

io.title: Import and export
io.export_hint: The effective catalog in the open format. Importing the file again gives the same catalog.
io.import_hint: You see a preview first. Imported items always arrive as proposed.
io.starter_counts: {{ abbs }} building blocks, {{ sbbs }} solutions, {{ rules }} rules
io.absent: In the catalog but not in the file (kept): {{ n }}
io.lands_proposed: Everything imported is saved as proposed, never as validated.
io.blocked: Fix the errors above before importing.

interview.title: Guided capture
interview.intro: Answer one question per lens. The assistant suggests catalog items; nothing is saved until you accept it.
interview.subject: Start from
interview.heading: Interview {{ id }}

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.kind_decider_nudge: A discussion you decide has gone quiet
notifications.kind_claim_expiring: A claim of yours is about to expire

discussions.title: Discussions
discussions.intro: Talk through a change to one catalog item, surface disagreement and leave a record of why.
discussions.empty_mine: You have not opened a discussion.
discussions.empty_orphaned: Every open discussion has an active decider.
discussions.empty_hint: Start one from an item page, or with the button above.
discussions.new_intro: Whoever opens a discussion decides it and closes it. A discussion is optional: an architect can also validate a change directly.
discussions.already_open: This item already has an open discussion.
discussions.item_id_hint: The id of an existing item, or of a new one if you give a proposal.
discussions.new_proposal: Proposal (JSON, optional for an existing item)
discussions.new_proposal_hint: The item as it should be. Required for an item that does not exist yet. It is saved as a draft that consultations never use until you accept it.
discussions.from_work: This discussion comes from work queue entry {{ n }}, which you claimed.
discussions.stale: The item was changed by someone else after this discussion opened (version {{ base }} to {{ latest }}). Differences:
discussions.no_proposal: No proposal has been saved yet. The decider can write one below.
discussions.no_changes: The proposal does not differ from the version this discussion started from.
discussions.proposal_version: Proposal saved as draft version {{ n }}. It does not affect consultations until it is accepted.
discussions.proposal_hint: Only the decider can change it. Every save keeps the earlier draft in the item history.
discussions.proposal_error_not_object: The proposal must be a JSON object.
discussions.validator: The validator found problems with this proposal:
discussions.impact_hint: Computed by the catalog, never by the language model: what depends on the item and what the proposal would change in reference cases and recent consultations.
discussions.nothing_changed: Nothing changed since the discussion opened.
discussions.mediator_hint: The mediator helps the conversation. It never decides and never changes the item. Its messages are AI-generated and cite the facts they rely on.
discussions.mediating: The mediator is working. The rest of the discussion keeps working meanwhile.
discussions.comment_hint: Write kind:id (for example sbb:acme-sms) to link a catalog item.
discussions.no_positions: Nobody has taken a position yet.
discussions.closed_note: This discussion is closed. A closed discussion is never reopened; a new one can refer to it.
discussions.draft_available: The mediator prepared a synthesis. You can use it, edit it or ignore it.
discussions.respond_to: Response to the objection of {{ who }}
discussions.ack_stale: I have read the newer version and still want to decide.
discussions.err_rationale: Write the rationale of the decision.
discussions.err_responses: Answer every opposing position before deciding: {{ who }}.
discussions.transfer_hint: The person you choose becomes the decider at once. This is recorded.
discussions.reassign_hint: As an administrator you can hand the decision to another architect, for example when the decider left.
discussions.consequence_accepted: The discussion closes and the proposal for {{ item }} becomes a version with status {{ status }}.
discussions.consequence_accepted_modified: The discussion closes and the modified proposal for {{ item }} becomes a version with status {{ status }}.
discussions.consequence_rejected: The discussion closes and {{ item }} stays as it is. The proposal remains in the history as a draft.
discussions.consequence_withdrawn: The discussion closes and nothing changes.
discussions.found_by_code: Found by the validator, not by the language model.
